name: Grelin's Report
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Grelin's Report carries word of the Frostmane trolls to Kharanos. It joins the scouts at Anvilmar with Senir Whitebeard and Ironforge.

sections.title: A Dispatch Past the Troggs
sections.body:
Grelin Whitebeard has watched the Frostmane trolls in Coldridge Valley and judges them no great threat. Mountaineers already stationed there can handle them, with mercenaries paid from Senate funds. So Grelin entrusts his report to a capable traveler instead of his fumbling apprentice. The journey leads through trogg-infested Coldridge Pass.

The paper shows Mountaineer Thalos that you travel on urgent business. With it, you may pass his blockade and enter the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Ruffling Feathers in Kharanos
sections.body: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Senir Whitebeard receives Grelin's field report for Ironforge. His brother has invoked King Magni Bronzebeard's name throughout the document, and Senir takes note with amused resignation. Grelin claims the King's sanction for his actions. Senir expects that appeal to royal authority to ruffle feathers in the Ironforge Senate.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Grelin's Report?
faq.answer: Grelin's Report carries Grelin Whitebeard's assessment of the Frostmane trolls from Coldridge Valley to Senir in Kharanos. It says they pose no great threat and can be handled by local Mountaineers and mercenaries paid by the Senate.

faq.q: Why can't Grelin deliver it himself?
aliases: why entrust it to an adventurer
faq.answer: Grelin remains in Coldridge Valley to watch the trolls. He first considered sending his apprentice, but the dangerous passage through the trogg-infested tunnel led him to entrust the papers to a battle-tested traveler.

faq.q: Why does Mountaineer Thalos let you pass with the report?
aliases: why does thalos let me through
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos guards the tunnel from Coldridge Valley to protect civilians from vicious troggs. Grelin's Report proves you travel on urgent dwarven defense business, so Thalos lets you pass.

faq.q: Why is the Ironforge Senate annoyed by the report?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard says Grelin invoked King Magni's name throughout the report. Though the brothers agree that Ironforge's politicians need a wake-up call, Senir expects Grelin's appeal to royal authority to ruffle feathers in the Senate.

angles.text: As a dwarf, carrying this report takes you from Coldridge's safe training grounds into Dun Morogh's heartland and the service of Ironforge.
As a gnome refugee, delivering Grelin's message lets you prove your mettle to dwarven mountaineers as you cross Dun Morogh's shared mountain passes.
